offering_description.value: Sells consumer cyber safety software and services covering antivirus, online privacy, identity protection and financial wellness. Customers are mainly individual consumers, who subscribe through direct online channels and partners. The company develops the software and runs the subscription services itself.

primary_products.value: antivirus and security software; VPN software; identity theft protection; password manager; PC performance optimization software

primary_services.value: identity restoration and monitoring; credit monitoring; online privacy services

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual consumers and families subscribing to security, privacy and identity protection; B2B: partners such as telecom carriers, banks and employers that bundle or resell offerings

end_markets.value: consumer cybersecurity; online privacy; identity protection; consumer financial wellness

revenue_model.value: subscription: recurring subscriptions to security, privacy and identity protection plans; licensing or royalties: partner and OEM licensing of security technology

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and operates security software and identity protection platforms sold to consumers; brand owner: owns consumer security brands marketed directly to individuals

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Asia-Pacific and other regions, large US customer base

specialization.value: related lines: antivirus, VPN, identity protection, privacy tools and financial wellness for consumers

distribution_channels.value: online: direct websites and app stores with subscription sales; partners / resellers: telecom carriers, device makers, retailers and financial institutions bundling offerings; third-party retail: boxed and card licenses at consumer electronics retailers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and consumer protection rules such as GDPR, CCPA and FTC, credit monitoring under FCRA
